commits.message: caretMark takes a shape only: a mark stands on its glyph's leading edge and ordering alone sets a right side (caretMarkOn), so no caller states an edge for orient to contradict; one turned style per row (rich-control-codes-xh4n.e1h)

The caret's side is set where the row is ordered: orient's displayed turns a caret mark to the level its glyph is shown at, so a masked or pictured row puts the bar where its shown glyphs do; CaretMark is branded to caretMark (rich-control-codes-xh4n.e1h)

BREAKING: Style.withCaret and StyleOptions.caret take a CaretMark (caretMark(shape, side)), not a CaretShape.

Review (high): caretSide re-derived levels from the raw value; replaced. Search bar keeps measure. The paint clamp for a right-side bar in the last column stays: no column exists past the screen's edge.

A bar caret in a right-to-left run stands on the insertion point's edge: Style.caret is a CaretMark, its shape and the side of its cell the insertion point is on, read off the levels the row is ordered by (rich-control-codes-xh4n.e1h)

TextInput reads glyph offsets off the frame's anchors (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7) (#564)

* A press reads its glyph off the frame it lands on: every drawn cell carries its offset, and the screen order is read off the drawn row (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7)

A multiline press judged whether the frame drew the end slot from the current
cursor, so after the cursor moved, a press in a right-to-left row landed a glyph
off. The row is now drawn once, each glyph stamped with a Slot, and the press and
the arrow keys read their stops from that drawn row; only under logical, where
the terminal orders the row, is shownOrder applied over it.

* Every stop survives ordering: a lone mark is shown on the stand-in, a gap row's end is a stop, a placeholder takes its own direction, and a row is stamped only while its stops are read (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7)

* Every offset a row holds is one of its stops: a cursor in what a wrap dropped stands on the row's end and steps out to the next row, a glyph is closed against its stand-in by the segmenter, a press past a right-to-left row reaches its end, and a logical row is ordered as the isolate the wire writes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7)

* A step reads the stops the painted frame recorded, an end drawn with no cell is ordered as the caret's blank, a logical row is ordered as sealed writes it with what follows it on its line, and a step back out of a row lands on the end a wrap dropped a gap after (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7)
